item.title: Readable Sale Copy Every Size

turns.text: I need matching plant-shop ads in 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9. Include exactly: “Fern House”, “Weekend Plant Sale”, “20% off all indoor plants”, “Saturday & Sunday”, “Visit 24 Willow Lane”. Use leafy plants and a clean green-and-cream look. Keep every line easy to read in all three, especially the address—rearrange things instead of shrinking the whole design.

item.tests: Preserves complete, readable ad copy and visual hierarchy when adapting one design to three substantially different canvas shapes.

must_haves: Three finished images have the requested 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9 aspect ratios.
All five specified text strings appear correctly and completely in every variant.
Every text line, including 'Visit 24 Willow Lane', is comfortably readable when each image is viewed at its delivered size without zooming.
Text has clear contrast against its background and is not obscured by leaves or other text.
No text is clipped, pushed against the canvas edge or distorted to fit.
The variants retain matching leafy imagery and green-and-cream styling while adjusting text placement or line breaks to suit each shape.

turns.text: I need a set of matching plant-shop ads, and I’m probably overthinking how to explain this because I want them to feel like they belong together. I always worry that an ad can look lovely at first glance but become hard to read when you actually try to find the details. The formats I need are 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9, and the wording to include exactly is “Fern House”, “Weekend Plant Sale”, “20% off all indoor plants”, “Saturday & Sunday”, “Visit 24 Willow Lane”. Please use leafy plants and a clean green-and-cream look across the set. Keep every line easy to read in all three, especially the address, and rearrange things to fit rather than shrinking the whole design.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the ads because Magic Hour reported **insufficient credits**. No images were created.

The coordinated layouts are ready:
- **1:1:** Centered text with leafy plants framing the lower corners.
- **9:16:** Spacious stacked text above the plants, with a separate address footer.
- **16:9:** Text on the left and plants on the right, with a clear address strip.

All three use cream backgrounds, forest-green typography and sage accents, preserving your five exact lines and giving **“Visit 24 Willow Lane”** prominent space—not fine print.

Once credits are available, I can retry the set.

Crisp large highly legible typography, generous whitespace, strong contrast, no lettering over foliage. Include ONLY these five exact text lines, spelled exactly: "Fern House"; "Weekend Plant Sale"; "20% off all indoor plants"; "Saturday & Sunday"; "Visit 24 Willow Lane". Hierarchy: brand at top, bold large sale headline, prominent offer, clear day line, prominent readable address in a separate cream footer with substantial padding. Square-specific layout: compact upper brand and headline, offer and days in clean central area, leafy plants framing lower corners but never obscuring text; address unobstructed across bottom. All five lines easy to read at small display size; especially address large and clear, never tiny. Keep sufficient safe margins. No extra words, logos, watermarks, or decorative pseudo-text. Rearrange composition for square rather than scaling down a portrait poster.
